zh.text: 今天唯一的一線希望是債券終於作為分散投資工具發揮作用（可能因為這次拋售不全是利率問題）。$TLT上漲1.3%，$AGG上漲0.62%，$LQD上漲0.59%。不多但總比過去幾年常與股票一起下跌好。不過$TLT五年圖表上有很多眼淚和損失。

en.text: If there's one silver lining today it's that bonds finally 'worked' as a diversifier (prob bc this selloff wasn't all about rates). $TLT up 1.3%, $AGG up 0.62%, $LQD up 0.59%. Not a lot but hey you'll take it bc a lot of times they go down with stocks past few years. All that said, here's $TLT 5-year chart. Lot of tears and lost cash in that chart.

zh.text: 標普 500 $SPX 相當緊密地追蹤 1978 年類比。那也是中期選舉年、通脹復蘇時期，以及馬年。

en.text: The S&P 500 $SPX is tracking 1978 analog pretty closely. It was also a mid term year, period of resurgent inflation, and also the year of the horse.

zh.text: damnang2 發帖稱終於發生了，引用 $QCOM 裁減超過 500 名加州員工及超過 1000 名印度員工的新聞，預期 Google 與 Microsoft 將跟進，並對股權下跌及失業的員工表示遺憾。 $QCOM

en.text: damnang2 posts Finally it happened quoting that $QCOM lays off over 500 California employees and over 1000 in India, expecting Google and Microsoft to follow, noting sadness for employees with down equities and lost jobs. $QCOM

zh.text: 丹·艾夫斯（@DivesTech）對股市拋售並不擔憂。人工智能和算力需求持續加速，儘管空頭持負面看法，基本面實際上在改善。

en.text: Dan Ives (@DivesTech) is not worried about the stock market sell-off. Demand for AI and compute continues to accelerate, with fundamentals improving despite bears negative view.

zh.text: 開始了... 債務變得昂貴。彭博報導 SpaceX 剛剛完成了 320 億美元的 Nvidia 芯片融資，利率超過 8%。據報導，美國高評級債券平均收益率為 5.95%。如果 SpaceX 以這些利率融資，我們肯定會看到對較小公司的更多壓力

en.text: Here we go... Debt has become expensive. Bloomberg reports that SpaceX has just completed their $32B financing for Nvidia chips at north of 8%. The average US high-grade bond yield is 5.95%, according to the report. If SpaceX finances at these rates, we're sure to see more pressure on smaller comp

zh.text: juan_gonzalesP 指出 @robin_j_brooks 剛剛標誌了宏觀中最重要的脫鉤：美元正在飆升，但它沒有追蹤利率差異。這是信用事件信號，不是利率交易。

en.text: juan_gonzalesP notes @robin_j_brooks just flagged the most important decoupling in macro: the dollar is surging, but it is NOT tracking rate differentials. This is a credit event signal, not a rates trade.

zh.text: First Squawk：布倫特原油期貨上漲 1.08 美元至每桶 93.03 美元。

en.text: First Squawk: Brent crude futures edge higher by $1.08 to $93.03/bbl.

zh.text: AI交易平倉導致科技領域大災難，大多數AI股今日下跌10%以上：$NVDA -11.8% $MU -12.9% $DELL -11.2% $AMD -11.9% $ANT -10.3% $AVGO -12.2% $SPCX -6.7% $TSLA -7.3%。安全科技股如$AAPL、$MSFT、$GOOG表現尚可：$AAPL -1.3% $MSFT -2.4% $GOOG -1.1%。擔憂相互關聯，包括特朗普政府相關因素。

en.text: The unwinding of the AI trade is causing absolute carnage in the tech arena, with most AI names down 10%+ today: $NVDA -11.8% $MU -12.9% $DELL -11.2% $AMD -11.9% $ANT -10.3% $AVGO -12.2% $SPCX -6.7% $TSLA -7.3%. Safe tech names like $AAPL, $MSFT, and $GOOG holding up fine: $AAPL -1.3% $MSFT -2.4% $GOOG -1.1%. Worries are interdependent including Trump administration related.
